purpose: Compare synthetic OAuth MCP article load at 0.5, 1 and 2 vCPU with separate load clients.

protocol.storage: Task-local Linux ext filesystem for control SQLite, Git content and derived index.
protocol.secondPass: Reversed load levels on the same server/client pair.
protocol.readerTraffic: Four full article reads plus one repeated sensor search per five requests; closed loop.
protocol.writerTraffic: Disjoint single-article saves after revision read; no measured retry.
protocol.warmup: Read, search, one save and verified historical readback before each timing window.
protocol.throughput: Successful request count divided by elapsed time including drain.
protocol.serverProcessMetrics: Node process and worker threads; excludes Git subprocesses.
protocol.containerMetrics: ECS metadata snapshots include supervisor and subprocesses but are asynchronously sampled.
protocol.limits: One allocation per server size, two passes. Warm closed-loop synthetic traffic, cached search phrase, no proxy/remote Git pushes/traces/evidence. No production capacity guarantee or persistent-storage qualification.

preflight.bootstrapFailure: Initial runtime extraction rejected a long archive path before any measurements. Bootstrap was corrected to extract only the verified Node binary.

coldWriterConflictFailure.qualification: Failed post-load first-write verification. Initial harness did not retain timings before verification; no throughput from this run is included.
coldWriterConflictFailure.resolution: Explicit verified writer warmup and retention of measured timing before subsequent correctness checks.

result.scope: Synthetic OAuth-authenticated article traffic; separately allocated client/server tasks when CPU_BENCH_REMOTE is set. Fixed clients (closed loop), no measured retries. Throughput includes drain time; successful and failed latencies are separate. Server CPU/RSS includes worker threads but excludes subprocesses. No proxy, remote pushes, conversations, or external evidence. Not a production capacity guarantee.
